verdict.rationale: The CLI installs non-interactively (`npm install -g` or `npx -y ultrametric@0.4.1`, verified keyless with exit 0), and `ultrametric init --dry-run --json` followed by `init` writes SKILL.md files for Codex and Claude Code. A keyless hands-on dry run previewed both harness targets with exit 0, and the `--json` mode is designed for agents to run without interactive prompts. Missing for 10: hands-on verification of the actual write step (only the dry run was recorded), and documentation of flags for selecting skills or harness targets with no prompt at all. [2026-10-14 re-judge parity audit (owner-product lane): full 8 -> partial 5, the standard both audits set on the same evidence: the recorded hands-on is a dry-run preview plus a tool install, not a completed skill install, and the peers' fulls (skills-cli/mattpocock-skills 9 high, superpowers 8 high) stand on recorded real end-to-end installs. The sign-in half of the flow is still unestablished headlessly. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
